functions.name: accept_loan_offer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_loan_offer(p_offer_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_borrower_id uuid := auth.uid();

    v_offer public.loan_offers%ROWTYPE;
    v_request public.loan_requests%ROWTYPE;
    v_lender_wallet public.wallets%ROWTYPE;

    v_loan_id uuid;
    v_interest_amount integer;
    v_new_funded integer;
    v_new_remaining integer;
    v_new_request_status text;
BEGIN

    -- ========================================================
    -- AUTHENTICATION
    -- ========================================================

    IF v_borrower_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LOCK OFFER
    -- ========================================================

    SELECT *
    INTO v_offer
    FROM public.loan_offers
    WHERE id = p_offer_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Offer not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_offer.borrower_id <> v_borrower_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only the borrower can accept this offer';
    END IF;

    IF v_offer.status <> 'OFFERED' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This offer is no longer available';
    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LOCK RELATED REQUEST
    -- ========================================================

    SELECT *
    INTO v_request
    FROM public.loan_requests
    WHERE id = v_offer.loan_request_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Related support request not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_request.borrower_id <> v_borrower_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Support request does not belong to borrower';
    END IF;

    -- IMPORTANT:
    -- Partially funded requests must still accept more offers.
    IF v_request.status NOT IN (
        'REQUESTED',
        'PARTIALLY_FUNDED'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This support request is no longer accepting funding';
    END IF;

    IF v_request.remaining_amount <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This support request is already fully funded';
    END IF;

    IF v_offer.amount > v_request.remaining_amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Offer exceeds the amount still required';
    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LOCK LENDER WALLET
    -- ========================================================

    SELECT *
    INTO v_lender_wallet
    FROM public.wallets
    WHERE user_id = v_offer.lender_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Lender wallet not found';
    END IF;

    -- Offer creation reserved these funds.
    IF v_lender_wallet.locked_balance < v_offer.amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Reserved support funds are no longer available';
    END IF;

    IF v_lender_wallet.balance < v_offer.amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Lender wallet balance is insufficient';
    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- ENSURE BORROWER WALLET EXISTS
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.wallets (
        user_id,
        balance,
        locked_balance
    )
    VALUES (
        v_borrower_id,
        0,
        0
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id)
    DO NOTHING;


    -- ========================================================
    -- CALCULATE NEW STATE
    -- ========================================================

    v_interest_amount :=
        v_offer.total_repayment - v_offer.amount;

    v_new_funded :=
        v_request.funded_amount + v_offer.amount;

    v_new_remaining :=
        greatest(
            0,
            v_request.remaining_amount - v_offer.amount
        );

    IF v_new_remaining = 0 THEN
        v_new_request_status := 'FULLY_FUNDED';
    ELSE
        v_new_request_status := 'PARTIALLY_FUNDED';
    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- TRANSFER PRINCIPAL
    -- ========================================================

    UPDATE public.wallets
    SET
        balance = balance - v_offer.amount,

        locked_balance = greatest(
            0,
            locked_balance - v_offer.amount
        ),

        updated_at = now()

    WHERE user_id = v_offer.lender_id;


    UPDATE public.wallets
    SET
        balance = balance + v_offer.amount,
        updated_at = now()

    WHERE user_id = v_borrower_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- CREATE LOAN AGREEMENT
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.loans (
        borrower_id,
        lender_id,
        loan_request_id,

        principal,
        interest_rate,
        interest_amount,
        total_repayment,

        amount_paid,
        principal_paid,
        lender_contribution,

        due_date,
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        v_borrower_id,
        v_offer.lender_id,
        v_offer.loan_request_id,

        v_offer.amount,
        v_offer.interest_rate,
        v_interest_amount,
        v_offer.total_repayment,

        0,
        0,
        v_offer.amount,

        now() + make_interval(
            days => v_offer.repayment_period_days
        ),

        'ACTIVE'
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_loan_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- MARK OFFER ACCEPTED
    -- ========================================================

    UPDATE public.loan_offers
    SET status = 'ACCEPTED'
    WHERE id = p_offer_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- UPDATE ORIGINAL REQUEST
    -- ========================================================

    UPDATE public.loan_requests
    SET
        funded_amount = v_new_funded,
        remaining_amount = v_new_remaining,
        status = v_new_request_status
    WHERE id = v_offer.loan_request_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- RECORD DISBURSEMENT
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.transactions (
        type,
        sender_id,
        recipient_id,
        amount,
        interest,
        loan_id,
        status,
        description
    )
    VALUES (
        'LOAN_DISBURSEMENT',
        v_offer.lender_id,
        v_borrower_id,
        v_offer.amount,
        v_interest_amount,
        v_loan_id,
        'COMPLETED',
        'Support funds disbursed'
    );


    -- ========================================================
    -- NOTIFY BORROWER
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.notifications (
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_borrower_id,
        'LOAN_ACCEPTED',
        'Support received',
        'Your support request received funding and the funds were added to your wallet.',
        v_loan_id
    );


    -- ========================================================
    -- NOTIFY LENDER
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.notifications (
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_offer.lender_id,
        'LOAN_ACCEPTED',
        'Support offer accepted',
        'Your support offer was accepted and the loan is now active.',
        v_loan_id
    );


    RETURN v_loan_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_loan_offer(p_request_id uuid, p_amount bigint, p_interest_rate numeric, p_period_days integer, p_approve_above_limit boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_request public.loan_requests%rowtype;
    v_wallet public.wallets%rowtype;
    v_id uuid;
    v_total bigint;
    v_max_interest numeric;

BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_request

    FROM public.loan_requests

    WHERE id = p_request_id

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND
       OR v_request.status NOT IN (
           'REQUESTED',
           'PARTIALLY_FUNDED'
       )
       OR v_request.expires_at <= now()
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Request is no longer available';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.direct_request_to IS NOT NULL
       AND v_request.direct_request_to <> auth.uid()
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This request is private';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.direct_request_to IS NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.connections c
            WHERE c.status = 'ACCEPTED'
              AND (
                  (
                      c.requester_id = auth.uid()
                      AND c.recipient_id =
                          v_request.borrower_id
                  )
                  OR
                  (
                      c.recipient_id = auth.uid()
                      AND c.requester_id =
                          v_request.borrower_id
                  )
              )
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Connect with this borrower first';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.borrower_id = auth.uid()
       OR p_amount <= 0
       OR p_amount > v_request.remaining_amount
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Invalid offer amount';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.above_limit_requested
       AND v_request.direct_request_to
           IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Above-limit requests are direct only';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.above_limit_requested
       AND NOT p_approve_above_limit
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Lender must explicitly approve this above-limit request';
    END IF;


    IF p_approve_above_limit
       AND (
           NOT v_request.above_limit_requested
           OR v_request.direct_request_to
               IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only the designated lender may approve an above-limit request';
    END IF;


    v_max_interest :=
        CASE
            WHEN v_request.above_limit_requested
                THEN 15
            ELSE 7
        END;


    IF p_interest_rate
        NOT BETWEEN 0 AND v_max_interest
       OR p_period_days
        NOT BETWEEN 7
        AND v_request.preferred_period_days
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Interest exceeds the limit for this request or the repayment period is invalid';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_wallet

    FROM public.wallets

    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND
       OR v_wallet.balance
          - v_wallet.locked_balance
          < p_amount
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Insufficient available wallet balance';
    END IF;


    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.lender_preferences lp

        WHERE lp.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND lp.maximum_lending_amount > 0
          AND p_amount >
              lp.maximum_lending_amount
    )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Offer exceeds your maximum lending amount';
    END IF;


    v_total :=
        p_amount
        + round(
            p_amount
            * p_interest_rate
            * p_period_days
            / 36500.0
        )::bigint;


    UPDATE public.wallets

    SET
        locked_balance =
            locked_balance + p_amount,

        updated_at = now()

    WHERE user_id = auth.uid();


    INSERT INTO public.loan_offers(
        loan_request_id,
        lender_id,
        borrower_id,
        amount,
        interest_rate,
        repayment_period_days,
        total_repayment,
        above_limit_override
    )
    VALUES(
        p_request_id,
        auth.uid(),
        v_request.borrower_id,
        p_amount,
        p_interest_rate,
        p_period_days,
        v_total,
        p_approve_above_limit
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_id;


    INSERT INTO public.notifications(
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES(
        v_request.borrower_id,
        'LOAN_OFFER',
        'New support offer',

        format(
            'A supporter offered KSh %s at %s%% for %s days%s.',
            p_amount,
            p_interest_rate,
            p_period_days,

            CASE
                WHEN v_request.above_limit_requested
                    THEN ' and approved your disclosed above-limit request'
                ELSE ''
            END
        ),

        v_id
    );


    RETURN v_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.decline_loan_offer(p_offer_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_offer public.loan_offers%rowtype;

BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.loan_requests

    WHERE id = (
        SELECT loan_request_id
        FROM public.loan_offers
        WHERE id = p_offer_id
    )

    FOR UPDATE;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_offer

    FROM public.loan_offers

    WHERE id = p_offer_id
      AND borrower_id = auth.uid()
      AND status IN (
          'OFFERED',
          'TERMS_REQUESTED'
      )

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Offer is no longer available';
    END IF;


    UPDATE public.loan_offers
    SET status = 'DECLINED'
    WHERE id = p_offer_id;


    UPDATE public.wallets

    SET
        locked_balance =
            greatest(
                0,
                locked_balance - v_offer.amount
            ),

        updated_at = now()

    WHERE user_id =
        v_offer.lender_id;


    INSERT INTO public.notifications(
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES(
        v_offer.lender_id,
        'LOAN_OFFER_DECLINED',
        'Offer declined',

        format(
            '%s declined your support offer.',
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = auth.uid()
            )
        ),

        p_offer_id
    );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_repaid_loan()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_borrower_name text;
BEGIN

    -- Extra safety:
    -- this function should only do anything when a loan
    -- actually transitions INTO REPAID.
    IF NEW.status <> 'REPAID'
       OR OLD.status = 'REPAID'
    THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Get the borrower's database name for the trust event.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT p.full_name
    INTO v_borrower_name
    FROM public.profiles p
    WHERE p.id = NEW.borrower_id;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Record completion in the existing Kash Trust system.
    --
    -- record_trust_event() already determines:
    --
    -- completed_at <= original_due_date -> +2
    -- completed_at <= extended due_date -> +1
    -- later than due_date               -> +0
    --
    -- It also prevents duplicate LOAN_COMPLETED rewards for
    -- the same loan.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    PERFORM public.record_trust_event(
        NEW.borrower_id,
        'LOAN_COMPLETED',
        0,
        'Loan fully repaid.',
        NEW.id
    );


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Refresh public/private borrower statistics including
    -- reliability_score and reliability_sample_size.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_statistics(
        NEW.borrower_id
    );


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Refresh lender statistics as the agreement is complete.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_statistics(
        NEW.lender_id
    );


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Recalculate borrowing capacity from the remaining
    -- outstanding principal.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_limit(
        NEW.borrower_id
    );


    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_direct_request_borrower_summary(p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(borrower_id uuid, full_name text, available_limit integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    r public.loan_requests%rowtype;

BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO r

    FROM public.loan_requests

    WHERE id = p_request_id
      AND direct_request_to =
          auth.uid()
      AND above_limit_requested;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This is not a direct above-limit request assigned to you';
    END IF;


    RETURN QUERY

    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.full_name,
        p.available_limit

    FROM public.profiles p

    WHERE p.id =
        r.borrower_id;

END;
$function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO public.kash_trust_state(
        user_id,
        cycle_peak,
        clean_cycle
    )
    VALUES(
        NEW.id,
        NEW.trust_score,
        NEW.trust_score = 0
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_username_available(p_username text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select not exists (
        select 1
        from public.profiles
        where lower(username) =
              lower(trim(leading '@' from p_username))
    );
$function$

functions.name: loan_reliability
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.loan_reliability(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(score integer, sample_size integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    SELECT
        trunc(
            100.0
            * count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE status = 'REPAID'
                  AND completed_at <= due_date
            )
            / nullif(count(*), 0)
        )::integer,

        count(*)::integer

    FROM public.loans

    WHERE borrower_id = p_user_id
      AND (
          status IN (
              'REPAID',
              'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
          )
          OR due_date <= now()
      );
$function$

functions.name: maintain_account_data
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.maintain_account_data(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    r public.loan_requests%rowtype;
    l public.loans%rowtype;
    u uuid;

BEGIN

    FOR u IN

        SELECT id
        FROM public.profiles

        WHERE p_user_id IS NULL
           OR id = p_user_id
           OR id IN (
               SELECT borrower_id
               FROM public.loans
               WHERE lender_id = p_user_id
           )

        ORDER BY id

    LOOP

        PERFORM public.apply_daily_trust_penalties(u);
        PERFORM public.refresh_profile_statistics(u);

    END LOOP;


    FOR r IN

        SELECT *
        FROM public.loan_requests

        WHERE status IN (
            'REQUESTED',
            'PARTIALLY_FUNDED'
        )
          AND expires_at <= now()
          AND (
              p_user_id IS NULL
              OR borrower_id = p_user_id
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM public.loan_offers o
                  WHERE o.loan_request_id =
                        loan_requests.id
                    AND o.lender_id =
                        p_user_id
              )
          )

        ORDER BY id
        FOR UPDATE

    LOOP

        PERFORM public.release_request_offers(r.id);

        UPDATE public.loan_requests
        SET status = 'EXPIRED'
        WHERE id = r.id;

    END LOOP;


    FOR l IN

        SELECT *
        FROM public.loans

        WHERE status IN (
            'ACTIVE',
            'DUE_SOON',
            'GRACE_PERIOD'
        )
          AND (
              p_user_id IS NULL
              OR borrower_id = p_user_id
              OR lender_id = p_user_id
          )

        ORDER BY id
        FOR UPDATE

    LOOP

        IF l.due_date <= now() THEN

            PERFORM public.mark_loan_overdue(l.id);


        ELSIF l.status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND l.due_date <= now() + interval '3 days'
        THEN

            UPDATE public.loans
            SET status = 'DUE_SOON'
            WHERE id = l.id;


            INSERT INTO public.notifications(
                user_id,
                type,
                title,
                message,
                related_entity_id
            )
            VALUES(
                l.borrower_id,
                'LOAN_DUE_SOON',
                'Loan due soon',

                format(
                    '%s, your repayment to %s is due within three days.',
                    (
                        SELECT full_name
                        FROM public.profiles
                        WHERE id = l.borrower_id
                    ),
                    (
                        SELECT full_name
                        FROM public.profiles
                        WHERE id = l.lender_id
                    )
                ),

                l.id
            );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;

END;
$function$

functions.name: mark_loan_overdue
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_loan_overdue(p_loan_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    l public.loans%rowtype;

BEGIN

    SELECT *
    INTO l
    FROM public.loans
    WHERE id = p_loan_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND
       OR l.status NOT IN (
           'ACTIVE',
           'DUE_SOON',
           'GRACE_PERIOD'
       )
       OR l.due_date > now()
    THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;


    UPDATE public.loans
    SET status = 'OVERDUE'
    WHERE id = l.id;


    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET borrowing_frozen = true
    WHERE id = l.borrower_id;


    INSERT INTO public.notifications(
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES
    (
        l.borrower_id,
        'LOAN_OVERDUE',
        'Loan overdue',

        format(
            '%s, your repayment to %s is overdue; new borrowing is frozen.',
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = l.borrower_id
            ),
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = l.lender_id
            )
        ),

        l.id
    ),
    (
        l.lender_id,
        'LOAN_OVERDUE',
        'Loan overdue',

        format(
            '%s has an overdue repayment.',
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = l.borrower_id
            )
        ),

        l.id
    );


    PERFORM public.record_trust_event(
        l.borrower_id,
        'OVERDUE',
        -40,
        'A loan became overdue.',
        l.id
    );

END;
$function$

functions.name: member_profile_details
functions.result: TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, username text, phone text, bio text, location text, member_since text, reliability_score integer, reliability_sample_size integer, current_debt_total bigint, current_debt_count integer, borrowing_limit bigint, available_limit bigint, previous_transaction_count integer, borrowing_count integer, completed_borrowing_count integer, minimum_borrowed bigint, maximum_borrowed bigint, average_borrowed bigint)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_profile_details(p_profile_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, username text, phone text, bio text, location text, member_since text, reliability_score integer, reliability_sample_size integer, current_debt_total bigint, current_debt_count integer, borrowing_limit bigint, available_limit bigint, previous_transaction_count integer, borrowing_count integer, completed_borrowing_count integer, minimum_borrowed bigint, maximum_borrowed bigint, average_borrowed bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    IF p_profile_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Choose a profile';
    END IF;


    RETURN QUERY

    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.full_name,
        p.username,
        p.phone,
        p.bio,
        p.location,

        to_char(
            p.created_at
            AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Nairobi',
            'YYYY-MM-DD'
        ),

        reliability.score,
        reliability.sample_size,

        coalesce(
            history.current_debt_total,
            0
        )::bigint,

        history.current_debt_count,

        p.borrowing_limit::bigint,

        greatest(
            0,
            p.borrowing_limit
            - coalesce(
                history.outstanding_principal,
                0
            )
        )::bigint,


        (
            SELECT count(*)::integer

            FROM public.transactions t

            WHERE (
                t.sender_id = p.id
                OR t.recipient_id = p.id
            )
            AND t.status = 'COMPLETED'
        ),


        history.borrowing_count,
        history.completed_borrowing_count,

        history.minimum_borrowed,
        history.maximum_borrowed,
        history.average_borrowed


    FROM public.profiles p


    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        public.loan_reliability(
            p.id
        ) reliability


    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

        SELECT

            sum(
                l.total_repayment
                - l.amount_paid
            )
            FILTER (
                WHERE l.status NOT IN (
                    'REPAID',
                    'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
                )
            )
            AS current_debt_total,


            count(*)
            FILTER (
                WHERE l.status NOT IN (
                    'REPAID',
                    'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
                )
            )::integer
            AS current_debt_count,


            sum(
                l.principal
                - l.principal_paid
            )
            FILTER (
                WHERE l.status NOT IN (
                    'REPAID',
                    'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
                )
            )
            AS outstanding_principal,


            count(*)::integer
            AS borrowing_count,


            count(*)
            FILTER (
                WHERE l.status = 'REPAID'
            )::integer
            AS completed_borrowing_count,


            min(l.principal)::bigint
            AS minimum_borrowed,


            max(l.principal)::bigint
            AS maximum_borrowed,


            trunc(
                avg(l.principal)
            )::bigint
            AS average_borrowed


        FROM public.loans l

        WHERE l.borrower_id =
            p.id

    ) history


    WHERE p.id =
        p_profile_id;

END;
$function$

functions.name: name_notification_participants
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.name_notification_participants()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    first_id uuid;
    second_id uuid;
    actor_name text;

BEGIN

    IF NEW.type IN (
        'CONNECTION_REQUEST',
        'CONNECTION_ACCEPTED',
        'CONNECTION_REJECTED'
    )
    THEN

        SELECT
            requester_id,
            recipient_id

        INTO
            first_id,
            second_id

        FROM public.connections

        WHERE id =
            NEW.related_entity_id;


    ELSIF NEW.type IN (
        'LOAN_OFFER',
        'LOAN_OFFER_TERMS_REQUESTED',
        'LOAN_OFFER_UPDATED',
        'LOAN_OFFER_DECLINED'
    )
    THEN

        SELECT
            borrower_id,
            lender_id

        INTO
            first_id,
            second_id

        FROM public.loan_offers

        WHERE id =
            NEW.related_entity_id;


    ELSIF NEW.type IN (
        'DIRECT_REQUEST',
        'NEW_LOAN_REQUEST'
    )
    THEN

        SELECT
            borrower_id,
            direct_request_to

        INTO
            first_id,
            second_id

        FROM public.loan_requests

        WHERE id =
            NEW.related_entity_id;


    ELSIF NEW.type IN (
        'LOAN_ACCEPTED',
        'LOAN_REPAID',
        'LOAN_PAYMENT',
        'LOAN_DUE_SOON',
        'LOAN_OVERDUE',
        'GRACE_PERIOD_GRANTED',
        'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
    )
    THEN

        SELECT
            borrower_id,
            lender_id

        INTO
            first_id,
            second_id

        FROM public.loans

        WHERE id =
            NEW.related_entity_id;


    ELSE
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;


    SELECT full_name
    INTO actor_name

    FROM public.profiles

    WHERE id =
        CASE
            WHEN first_id =
                 NEW.user_id
                THEN second_id
            ELSE first_id
        END;


    IF actor_name IS NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;


    NEW.message :=
        replace(
            replace(
                replace(
                    replace(
                        replace(
                            NEW.message,
                            'The borrower',
                            actor_name
                        ),
                        'A supporter',
                        actor_name
                    ),
                    'The supporter',
                    actor_name
                ),
                'Your lender',
                actor_name
            ),
            'A loan you supported',
            actor_name || '''s loan'
        );


    IF NEW.message IN (
        'You received a connection request.',
        'Your connection request was accepted.',
        'Your connection request was declined.'
    )
    THEN

        NEW.message :=
            actor_name ||

            CASE NEW.type
                WHEN 'CONNECTION_REQUEST'
                    THEN ' sent you a connection request.'
                WHEN 'CONNECTION_ACCEPTED'
                    THEN ' accepted your connection request.'
                ELSE
                    ' declined your connection request.'
            END;

    END IF;


    RETURN NEW;

END;
$function$

functions.name: normalize_ke_phone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_ke_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    WITH digits AS (
        SELECT pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
            p_phone,
            '[^0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
        ) AS value
    )
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN value ~ '^0[17][0-9]{8}$'
            THEN '254' || pg_catalog.substr(value, 2)
        WHEN value ~ '^[17][0-9]{8}$'
            THEN '254' || value
        WHEN value ~ '^254[17][0-9]{8}$'
            THEN value
        ELSE value
    END
    FROM digits;
$function$

functions.arguments: p_user_id uuid, p_event_type text, p_points integer, p_description text, p_loan_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_trust_event(p_user_id uuid, p_event_type text, p_points integer, p_description text, p_loan_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    p public.profiles%rowtype;
    s public.kash_trust_state%rowtype;

    v_id uuid;
    v_points integer;
    v_score integer;
    v_limit integer;
    v_rate integer;

BEGIN

    IF p_event_type IN (
        'COMMUNITY_SUPPORT',
        'LOAN_COMPLETED'
    )
    THEN
        PERFORM public.apply_daily_trust_penalties(
            p_user_id
        );
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO STRICT p
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = p_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    INSERT INTO public.kash_trust_state(
        user_id,
        cycle_peak,
        clean_cycle
    )
    VALUES(
        p.id,
        p.trust_score,
        p.trust_score = 0
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;


    SELECT *
    INTO STRICT s
    FROM public.kash_trust_state
    WHERE user_id = p.id
    FOR UPDATE;


    v_points :=
        CASE p_event_type

            WHEN 'COMMUNITY_SUPPORT'
                THEN 2

            WHEN 'LOAN_COMPLETED'
                THEN (
                    SELECT CASE
                        WHEN completed_at <= original_due_date
                            THEN 2
                        WHEN completed_at <= due_date
                            THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                    FROM public.loans
                    WHERE id = p_loan_id
                )

            WHEN 'DAILY_DELAY'
                THEN -10

            ELSE 0

        END;


    v_points := coalesce(v_points, 0);


    IF p_event_type IN (
        'COMMUNITY_SUPPORT',
        'LOAN_COMPLETED'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.trust_events
        WHERE user_id = p.id
          AND event_type = p_event_type
          AND related_loan_id = p_loan_id
    )
    THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;


    INSERT INTO public.trust_events(
        user_id,
        event_type,
        points,
        description,
        related_loan_id
    )
    VALUES(
        p.id,
        p_event_type,
        v_points,
        p_description,
        p_loan_id
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_id;


    v_score := p.trust_score + v_points;
    v_limit := p.borrowing_limit;


    IF v_points < 0 THEN

        s.clean_cycle := false;

        v_limit :=
            trunc(
                v_limit::numeric
                * power(0.98::numeric, 1.0 / 7)
            )::integer;


        IF p.trust_score > 0
           AND v_score <= 0
        THEN

            v_rate :=
                CASE
                    WHEN s.cycle_peak = 1000 THEN 40
                    WHEN s.cycle_peak > 900 THEN 35
                    WHEN s.cycle_peak > 800 THEN 30
                    WHEN s.cycle_peak > 700 THEN 25
                    WHEN s.cycle_peak > 600 THEN 15
                    WHEN s.cycle_peak > 500 THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
                END;


            IF v_rate > 0 THEN

                v_rate :=
                    least(
                        100,
                        v_rate + 5 * s.decline_cycles
                    );


                v_limit :=
                    trunc(
                        v_limit::numeric
                        * (1 - v_rate / 100.0)
                    )::integer;


                s.decline_cycles :=
                    s.decline_cycles + 1;


                INSERT INTO public.notifications(
                    user_id,
                    type,
                    title,
                    message,
                    related_entity_id
                )
                VALUES(
                    p.id,
                    'LIMIT_DECREASED',
                    'Kash Trust decline cycle',

                    format(
                        '%s, your Kash Trust fell from a peak of %s to zero. An additional %s%% reduction leaves your borrowing limit at KSh %s.',
                        p.full_name,
                        s.cycle_peak,
                        v_rate,
                        v_limit
                    ),

                    p_loan_id
                );

            END IF;


            s.cycle_peak := 0;

        END IF;


        IF v_score < 0 THEN

            v_score := 1000 + v_score;
            s.cycle_peak := 1000;

        END IF;


    ELSIF v_points > 0 THEN

        IF v_score >= 1000 THEN

            v_limit :=
                least(
                    2147483647,
                    trunc(
                        v_limit::numeric * 1.02
                    )
                )::integer;


            IF s.clean_cycle THEN

                v_limit :=
                    least(
                        2147483647,
                        trunc(
                            v_limit::numeric * 1.02
                        )
                    )::integer;

            END IF;


            INSERT INTO public.notifications(
                user_id,
                type,
                title,
                message,
                related_entity_id
            )
            VALUES(
                p.id,
                'LIMIT_INCREASED',
                'Kash Trust milestone',

                format(
                    '%s, you reached 1000 Kash Trust points. Your limit increased by 2%%%s to KSh %s.',
                    p.full_name,
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.clean_cycle
                            THEN ' plus a further 2% for a deduction-free cycle'
                        ELSE ''
                    END,
                    v_limit
                ),

                p_loan_id
            );


            v_score := v_score - 1000;

            s.cycle_peak := v_score;
            s.clean_cycle := true;


        ELSE

            s.cycle_peak :=
                greatest(
                    s.cycle_peak,
                    v_score
                );

        END IF;

    END IF;


    UPDATE public.profiles

    SET
        trust_score = v_score,
        borrowing_limit = v_limit,
        available_limit =
            least(
                available_limit,
                v_limit
            )

    WHERE id = p.id;


    UPDATE public.kash_trust_state

    SET
        cycle_peak = s.cycle_peak,
        clean_cycle = s.clean_cycle,
        decline_cycles = s.decline_cycles

    WHERE user_id = p.id;


    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_limit(
        p.id
    );


    IF v_points <> 0 THEN

        INSERT INTO public.notifications(
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            message,
            related_entity_id
        )
        VALUES(
            p.id,

            CASE
                WHEN v_points < 0
                    THEN 'TRUST_DECREASED'
                ELSE 'TRUST_INCREASED'
            END,

            'Kash Trust activity',

            format(
                '%s, %s Kash Trust points: %s Your points are %s/1000; borrowing limit KSh %s.',
                p.full_name,
                v_points,
                p_description,
                v_score,
                v_limit
            ),

            p_loan_id
        );

    END IF;


    RETURN v_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_profile_limit(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN

    UPDATE public.profiles p

    SET available_limit =
        greatest(
            0,
            p.borrowing_limit -
            (
                SELECT coalesce(
                    sum(principal - principal_paid),
                    0
                )
                FROM public.loans
                WHERE borrower_id = p.id
                  AND status NOT IN (
                      'REPAID',
                      'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
                  )
            )
        )

    WHERE p.id = p_user_id;

END;
$function$

functions.name: refresh_profile_statistics
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_profile_statistics(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN

    UPDATE public.profiles p

    SET
        completed_loans = (
            SELECT count(*)
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE borrower_id = p.id
              AND status = 'REPAID'
        ),

        overdue_loans = (
            SELECT count(*)
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE borrower_id = p.id
              AND status IN (
                  'OVERDUE',
                  'DEFAULTED'
              )
        ),

        active_loans = (
            SELECT count(*)
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE borrower_id = p.id
              AND status NOT IN (
                  'REPAID',
                  'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'
              )
        ),

        total_borrowed = (
            SELECT coalesce(sum(principal), 0)
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE borrower_id = p.id
        ),

        total_repaid = (
            SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_paid), 0)
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE borrower_id = p.id
        ),

        total_supported = (
            SELECT coalesce(sum(principal), 0)
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE lender_id = p.id
        ),

        total_earned_from_interest = (
            SELECT coalesce(
                sum(amount_paid - principal_paid),
                0
            )
            FROM public.loans
            WHERE lender_id = p.id
        ),

        repayment_ratio =
            coalesce(
                (
                    SELECT score
                    FROM public.loan_reliability(p.id)
                ),
                0
            ),

        reliability_score = (
            SELECT score
            FROM public.loan_reliability(p.id)
        ),

        reliability_sample_size = (
            SELECT sample_size
            FROM public.loan_reliability(p.id)
        )

    WHERE p.id = p_user_id;

END;
$function$

functions.name: repay_loan
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.repay_loan(p_loan_id uuid, p_amount bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_loan public.loans%rowtype;
    v_wallet public.wallets%rowtype;
    v_borrower public.profiles%rowtype;

    v_amount bigint;
    v_principal bigint;
    v_completed boolean;

BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_loan

    FROM public.loans

    WHERE id = p_loan_id
      AND borrower_id = auth.uid()

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND
       OR v_loan.status NOT IN (
           'ACTIVE',
           'DUE_SOON',
           'OVERDUE',
           'GRACE_PERIOD'
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Loan cannot be repaid';
    END IF;


    PERFORM public.apply_daily_trust_penalties(
        v_loan.borrower_id
    );


    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id IN (
        v_loan.borrower_id,
        v_loan.lender_id
    )
    ORDER BY id
    FOR UPDATE;


    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.wallets
    WHERE user_id IN (
        v_loan.borrower_id,
        v_loan.lender_id
    )
    ORDER BY user_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    v_amount :=
        least(
            p_amount,
            v_loan.total_repayment
            - v_loan.amount_paid
        );


    IF v_amount <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Payment amount must be positive';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_wallet

    FROM public.wallets

    WHERE user_id =
        v_loan.borrower_id

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF v_wallet.balance < v_amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Insufficient wallet balance';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_borrower

    FROM public.profiles

    WHERE id =
        v_loan.borrower_id

    FOR UPDATE;


    v_principal :=
        least(
            v_amount,
            v_loan.principal
            - v_loan.principal_paid
        );


    v_completed :=
        v_loan.amount_paid
        + v_amount
        >= v_loan.total_repayment;


    UPDATE public.wallets

    SET
        balance =
            balance - v_amount,

        updated_at = now()

    WHERE user_id =
        v_loan.borrower_id;


    UPDATE public.wallets

    SET
        balance =
            balance + v_amount,

        updated_at = now()

    WHERE user_id =
        v_loan.lender_id;


    UPDATE public.loans

    SET
        amount_paid =
            amount_paid + v_amount,

        principal_paid =
            principal_paid + v_principal,

        status =
            CASE
                WHEN v_completed
                    THEN 'REPAID'
                ELSE status
            END,

        completed_at =
            CASE
                WHEN v_completed
                    THEN now()
                ELSE completed_at
            END

    WHERE id =
        v_loan.id;


    INSERT INTO public.loan_payments(
        loan_id,
        payer_id,
        amount,
        payment_type
    )
    VALUES(
        v_loan.id,
        v_loan.borrower_id,
        v_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN v_principal = v_amount
                THEN 'PRINCIPAL'
            WHEN v_principal = 0
                THEN 'INTEREST'
            ELSE 'MIXED'
        END
    );


    INSERT INTO public.transactions(
        sender_id,
        recipient_id,
        amount,
        type,
        status,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES(
        v_loan.borrower_id,
        v_loan.lender_id,
        v_amount,
        'LOAN_REPAYMENT',
        'COMPLETED',
        v_loan.id
    );


    INSERT INTO public.notifications(
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES
    (
        v_loan.borrower_id,
        'LOAN_PAYMENT',
        'Payment sent',

        format(
            '%s, KSh %s was paid to %s.',
            v_borrower.full_name,
            v_amount,
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id =
                    v_loan.lender_id
            )
        ),

        v_loan.id
    ),
    (
        v_loan.lender_id,
        'LOAN_PAYMENT',
        'Payment received',

        format(
            '%s paid you KSh %s.',
            v_borrower.full_name,
            v_amount
        ),

        v_loan.id
    );


    IF v_completed THEN

        PERFORM public.record_trust_event(
            v_loan.borrower_id,
            'LOAN_COMPLETED',
            0,
            'Loan fully repaid.',
            v_loan.id
        );

    END IF;


    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_statistics(
        v_loan.borrower_id
    );

    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_statistics(
        v_loan.lender_id
    );

    PERFORM public.refresh_profile_limit(
        v_loan.borrower_id
    );

END;
$function$

functions.name: repay_loan_once
functions.arguments: p_loan_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_operation_id text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.repay_loan_once(p_loan_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_operation_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE

    v_borrower_id uuid := auth.uid();

    v_loan public.loans%ROWTYPE;

    v_remaining integer;

    v_interest_already_paid integer;
    v_interest_remaining integer;

    v_interest_payment integer;
    v_principal_payment integer;

    v_new_amount_paid integer;
    v_new_principal_paid integer;

    v_fully_repaid boolean;

BEGIN

    -- ========================================================
    -- AUTHENTICATION
    -- ========================================================

    IF v_borrower_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;


    IF p_operation_id IS NULL
       OR btrim(p_operation_id) = '' THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Payment operation ID is required';

    END IF;


    IF p_amount IS NULL
       OR p_amount <= 0 THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Repayment amount must be greater than zero';

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- IDEMPOTENCY
    --
    -- If the phone retries the same payment because of a
    -- timeout/network issue, DO NOT charge the borrower twice.
    -- ========================================================

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.repayment_operations
        WHERE operation_id = p_operation_id
          AND loan_id = p_loan_id
          AND borrower_id = v_borrower_id
          AND amount = p_amount
    ) THEN

        RETURN;

    END IF;


    -- Same operation ID cannot be reused for another payment.

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.repayment_operations
        WHERE operation_id = p_operation_id
    ) THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Payment operation ID has already been used';

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LOCK THE LOAN
    -- ========================================================

    SELECT *
    INTO v_loan
    FROM public.loans
    WHERE id = p_loan_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Loan not found';
    END IF;


    IF v_loan.borrower_id <> v_borrower_id THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only the borrower can repay this loan';

    END IF;


    IF v_loan.status NOT IN (
        'ACTIVE',
        'DUE_SOON',
        'OVERDUE',
        'GRACE_PERIOD'
    ) THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This loan cannot currently receive repayments';

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- OUTSTANDING BALANCE
    -- ========================================================

    v_remaining :=
        v_loan.total_repayment -
        v_loan.amount_paid;


    IF v_remaining <= 0 THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This loan has already been repaid';

    END IF;


    -- Do not allow overpayment.

    IF p_amount > v_remaining THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Repayment exceeds outstanding loan balance';

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LOCK + CHECK BORROWER WALLET
    -- ========================================================

    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.wallets
    WHERE user_id = v_borrower_id
      AND balance >= p_amount
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Insufficient wallet balance';

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LOCK LENDER WALLET
    -- ========================================================

    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.wallets
    WHERE user_id = v_loan.lender_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Lender wallet not found';

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- PAYMENT ALLOCATION
    --
    -- Interest is paid first, then principal.
    --
    -- Example:
    --
    -- Principal = 2000
    -- Interest  = 20
    -- Payment   = 500
    --
    -- Interest payment = 20
    -- Principal payment = 480
    -- ========================================================


    v_interest_already_paid :=
        greatest(
            0,
            v_loan.amount_paid -
            v_loan.principal_paid
        );


    v_interest_remaining :=
        greatest(
            0,
            v_loan.interest_amount -
            v_interest_already_paid
        );


    v_interest_payment :=
        least(
            p_amount,
            v_interest_remaining
        );


    v_principal_payment :=
        p_amount -
        v_interest_payment;


    v_new_amount_paid :=
        v_loan.amount_paid +
        p_amount;


    v_new_principal_paid :=
        least(
            v_loan.principal,
            v_loan.principal_paid +
            v_principal_payment
        );


    v_fully_repaid :=
        v_new_amount_paid >=
        v_loan.total_repayment;


    -- ========================================================
    -- REGISTER OPERATION
    --
    -- This is in the SAME PostgreSQL transaction.
    -- If anything below fails, this insert is rolled back too.
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.repayment_operations (
        operation_id,
        loan_id,
        borrower_id,
        amount
    )
    VALUES (
        p_operation_id,
        p_loan_id,
        v_borrower_id,
        p_amount
    );


    -- ========================================================
    -- MOVE MONEY
    -- BORROWER -> LENDER
    -- ========================================================

    UPDATE public.wallets
    SET
        balance = balance - p_amount,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE user_id = v_borrower_id;


    UPDATE public.wallets
    SET
        balance = balance + p_amount,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE user_id = v_loan.lender_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- UPDATE LOAN
    -- ========================================================

    UPDATE public.loans
    SET

        amount_paid =
            v_new_amount_paid,

        principal_paid =
            v_new_principal_paid,

        status =
            CASE
                WHEN v_fully_repaid
                    THEN 'REPAID'
                ELSE status
            END,

        completed_at =
            CASE
                WHEN v_fully_repaid
                    THEN now()
                ELSE completed_at
            END

    WHERE id = p_loan_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- TRANSACTION HISTORY
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.transactions (
        type,
        sender_id,
        recipient_id,
        amount,
        interest,
        loan_id,
        status,
        description
    )
    VALUES (
        'LOAN_REPAYMENT',
        v_borrower_id,
        v_loan.lender_id,
        p_amount,
        v_interest_payment,
        p_loan_id,
        'COMPLETED',

        CASE
            WHEN v_fully_repaid
                THEN 'Loan repaid in full'
            ELSE
                'Partial loan repayment'
        END
    );


    -- ========================================================
    -- RESTORE BORROWING CAPACITY
    --
    -- Only principal restores borrowing capacity.
    -- Interest does not.
    -- ========================================================

    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET

        available_limit =
            least(
                borrowing_limit,
                available_limit +
                v_principal_payment
            ),

        total_repaid =
            total_repaid +
            p_amount

    WHERE id = v_borrower_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- LENDER INTEREST STATISTICS
    -- ========================================================

    IF v_interest_payment > 0 THEN

        UPDATE public.profiles
        SET
            total_earned_from_interest =
                total_earned_from_interest +
                v_interest_payment
        WHERE id = v_loan.lender_id;

    END IF;


    -- ========================================================
    -- NOTIFY LENDER
    -- ========================================================

    INSERT INTO public.notifications (
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES (

        v_loan.lender_id,

        CASE
            WHEN v_fully_repaid
                THEN 'LOAN_REPAID'
            ELSE
                'LOAN_PAYMENT'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN v_fully_repaid
                THEN 'Loan repaid'
            ELSE
                'Repayment received'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN v_fully_repaid
                THEN
                    'The borrower has completed repayment of this loan.'
            ELSE
                'The borrower made a partial repayment on this loan.'
        END,

        p_loan_id
    );


    -- ========================================================
    -- FULL REPAYMENT ONLY
    -- ========================================================

    IF v_fully_repaid THEN


        -- Notify borrower.

        INSERT INTO public.notifications (
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            message,
            related_entity_id
        )
        VALUES (
            v_borrower_id,
            'LOAN_REPAID',
            'Loan repaid',
            'You have successfully completed repayment of this loan.',
            p_loan_id
        );


        -- Only mark the original support request REPAID when
        -- every associated loan has finished.

        IF NOT EXISTS (

            SELECT 1
            FROM public.loans

            WHERE loan_request_id =
                  v_loan.loan_request_id

              AND id <> p_loan_id

              AND status NOT IN (
                  'REPAID',
                  'RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY',
                  'CANCELLED'
              )

        ) THEN

            UPDATE public.loan_requests
            SET status = 'REPAID'
            WHERE id =
                  v_loan.loan_request_id;

        END IF;


    END IF;

END;
$function$

functions.name: request_loan_offer_terms
functions.arguments: p_offer_id uuid, p_interest_rate integer, p_period_days integer

functions.name: request_loan_offer_terms
functions.arguments: p_offer_id uuid, p_interest_rate numeric, p_period_days integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_loan_offer_terms(p_offer_id uuid, p_interest_rate numeric, p_period_days integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_offer public.loan_offers%rowtype;

BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.loan_requests

    WHERE id = (
        SELECT loan_request_id
        FROM public.loan_offers
        WHERE id = p_offer_id
    )

    FOR UPDATE;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_offer

    FROM public.loan_offers

    WHERE id = p_offer_id
      AND borrower_id = auth.uid()
      AND status = 'OFFERED'

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Offer is no longer available';
    END IF;


    IF p_interest_rate
        NOT BETWEEN 0
        AND v_offer.interest_rate
       OR p_period_days
        NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 365
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Requested terms must use equal-or-lower interest and a 7-365 day period';
    END IF;


    UPDATE public.loan_offers

    SET
        status = 'TERMS_REQUESTED',
        requested_interest_rate =
            p_interest_rate,
        requested_repayment_period_days =
            p_period_days

    WHERE id = p_offer_id;


    INSERT INTO public.notifications(
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES(
        v_offer.lender_id,
        'LOAN_OFFER_TERMS_REQUESTED',
        'Terms requested',

        format(
            '%s requested %s%% for %s days.',
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = auth.uid()
            ),
            p_interest_rate,
            p_period_days
        ),

        p_offer_id
    );

END;
$function$

functions.name: respond_connection_request
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.respond_connection_request(p_connection_id uuid, p_accept boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
    v_connection public.connections%ROWTYPE;
    v_responder_name text;
BEGIN

    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_connection
    FROM public.connections
    WHERE id = p_connection_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Connection request not found';
    END IF;


    -- Only the person receiving the request may respond.
    IF v_connection.recipient_id <> v_user_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only the recipient can respond to this request';
    END IF;


    IF v_connection.status <> 'PENDING' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This connection request has already been handled';
    END IF;


    SELECT full_name
    INTO v_responder_name
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = v_user_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- ACCEPT
    -- ========================================================

    IF p_accept THEN

        UPDATE public.connections
        SET
            status = 'ACCEPTED',
            accepted_at = now(),
            responded_at = now()
        WHERE id = p_connection_id;


        -- Notify original requester.
        INSERT INTO public.notifications (
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            message,
            related_entity_id
        )
        VALUES (
            v_connection.requester_id,
            'CONNECTION_ACCEPTED',
            'Connection accepted',
            coalesce(v_responder_name, 'Someone') ||
                ' accepted your connection request.',
            p_connection_id
        );


    -- ========================================================
    -- REJECT
    -- ========================================================

    ELSE

        UPDATE public.connections
        SET
            status = 'REJECTED',
            responded_at = now()
        WHERE id = p_connection_id;


        -- Notify original requester.
        INSERT INTO public.notifications (
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            message,
            related_entity_id
        )
        VALUES (
            v_connection.requester_id,
            'CONNECTION_REJECTED',
            'Connection request declined',
            coalesce(v_responder_name, 'Someone') ||
                ' declined your connection request.',
            p_connection_id
        );

    END IF;

END;
$function$

functions.name: respond_loan_offer_terms
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.respond_loan_offer_terms(p_offer_id uuid, p_accept_terms boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_offer public.loan_offers%rowtype;
    v_rate numeric;
    v_days integer;

BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sign in first'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;


    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.loan_requests

    WHERE id = (
        SELECT loan_request_id
        FROM public.loan_offers
        WHERE id = p_offer_id
    )

    FOR UPDATE;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_offer

    FROM public.loan_offers

    WHERE id = p_offer_id
      AND lender_id = auth.uid()
      AND status = 'TERMS_REQUESTED'

    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Terms request is no longer available';
    END IF;


    v_rate :=
        CASE
            WHEN p_accept_terms
                THEN v_offer.requested_interest_rate
            ELSE v_offer.interest_rate
        END;


    v_days :=
        CASE
            WHEN p_accept_terms
                THEN v_offer.requested_repayment_period_days
            ELSE v_offer.repayment_period_days
        END;


    UPDATE public.loan_offers

    SET
        status = 'OFFERED',

        interest_rate = v_rate,

        repayment_period_days =
            v_days,

        total_repayment =
            amount
            + round(
                amount
                * v_rate
                * v_days
                / 36500.0
            )::bigint,

        requested_interest_rate = NULL,

        requested_repayment_period_days =
            NULL

    WHERE id = p_offer_id;


    INSERT INTO public.notifications(
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        related_entity_id
    )
    VALUES(
        v_offer.borrower_id,
        'LOAN_OFFER_UPDATED',
        'Offer terms updated',

        format(
            '%s responded with %s%% interest for %s days.',
            (
                SELECT full_name
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = auth.uid()
            ),
            v_rate,
            v_days
        ),

        p_offer_id
    );

END;
$function$
